differences.title: 1. API DESIGN
differences.leftDesc: Intuitive, Python-first, easy to learn and debug.
differences.rightDesc: Define and then execute graph, good for optimization.

differences.title: 2. DEVELOPMENT EASE
differences.leftDesc: Great for research and rapid iteration, easier debugging.
differences.rightDesc: More setup, but powerful for complex deployments.

differences.title: 3. PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
differences.leftDesc: TorchServe and mobile support are improving rapidly.
differences.rightDesc: TensorFlow Serving, Lite, JS offer robust options.

differences.title: 4. COMMUNITY
differences.leftDesc: Strong in academia, active forums and GitHub.

differences.title: 5. FLEXIBILITY
differences.leftDesc: Dynamic computation graphs allow for easier experimentation.
differences.rightDesc: Static graphs can be harder to modify post-definition.

differences.title: 6. AUTO-DIFFERENTIATION
differences.leftDesc: Intuitive gradient calculation via dynamic graphs.
differences.rightDesc: Optimized graph execution with session management.

differences.title: 7. HARDWARE SUPPORT
differences.leftDesc: Good support for GPUs and various hardware.
differences.rightDesc: Highly optimized for Google's TPUs and diverse hardware.
